
{{alias}}( dtype )
    Returns a constructor for creating an SGD trainer parameters object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dtype: string
        Floating-point data type for storing floating-point parameters.

    Returns
    -------
    fcn: Function
        Constructor.

    Examples
    --------
    > var P = {{alias}}( 'float64' );
    > var p = new P();
    > p.toString()
    <string>

    See Also
    --------
